# Try converting all 8 dots to squares at once
# Dot positions: (37,18), (37,41), (40,37), (41,16), (54,49), (55,14), (56,47), (57,16)
dots = [(37,18), (37,41), (40,37), (41,16), (54,49), (55,14), (56,47), (57,16)]

print(f"  Magenta squares: {len(m_squares)}")
for n in m_squares:
    b = n['boundary']
    rows = [p[0] for p in b]
    cols = [p[1] for p in b]
    print(f"    rows={min(rows)}-{max(rows)}, cols={min(cols)}-{max(cols)}")

print(f"  Sky blue dots remaining: {len(s_dots)}")

for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'W':
        print(f"  White bar: pixels={n['pixels']}")
    if n['color'] == 'b' and n['pixels'] > 10:
        print(f"  Blue circle: pixels={n['pixels']}")

print(f"Level completed: {last_action_result.get('level_completed')}")
print(f"Score: {last_action_result.get('score')}")
print(f"Done: {last_action_result.get('done')}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
